answer: To resist sybils, the collective binds each agent identity to a bonded stake escrowed under a walnut-hardened key ceremony, so a sudden gale of fake registrations cannot ripple through governance without collateral. Reputation is then weighted by peer-attested tenure rather than raw count, forcing colluders to sustain costly long-horizon participation before any voting ripple. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
